question: Does one bounded second discrepancy improve the quality and stability of proper-discrepancy search without turning the catch-up tournament into an unbounded beam?

implementation.retirement: The behavior-neutral map environment is removed from the parser; its artifacts remain analyzable.
implementation.route_identity: Every probe records discrepancy depth zero for a causal route, one for the first local route, or two for the nested route. Each local route names its exact parent route and parent choice.
schedule: run the unchanged primary causal catch-up
only after it reaches equal depth and loses, choose and run one proper first discrepancy
only after that first discrepancy reaches equal depth and loses, choose and run one proper nested discrepancy generated by that exact route
rank the suspended prefix and every completed route once by unchanged strict authored-axis loss
bounds: at most one route at discrepancy depth one and one at depth two
no third discrepancy and no recursive choice collection on depth two
both choices require positive incumbent-relative prefix gain, nonzero remaining advance, frontier liveness, and no deadline pressure
both use stable maximum gain times conservative deadline margin
trigger, causal sibling, candidate generation, node expansion, deadline, repair, terminal, register, and scoring behavior are unchanged
trust: the analyzer validates depth, exact parent route and choice, stable argmax, and nonzero advance
a nested route requires the causal and first-local routes both to have reached target and lost
probe, target-reach, and selected aggregates are split for depth two

mechanical_smoke.scope: Known opportunity-map actual seed 128; believer pair plus three controls at 750k. Score is excluded from decision evidence.
mechanical_smoke.interpretation: All three known opportunities execute as exactly attributed depth-two routes and reach target. None wins this known smoke; score is excluded and the fresh screen remains necessary.

predeclared_screen.decision: Advance to a fresh two-seed all-catalog 750k breadth screen only if all cells retain validity, total target completed-track movement is positive, at least five of eight target seed blocks are positive, both target-source sums are positive, at least four target cells improve, no target cell loses 20 or more points, nested routes execute in at least six target runs and both requested sources, and every analyzer trust check passes. Otherwise close without catalog or canonical evaluation.
predeclared_screen.next_if_passed: Use fresh actual seeds 146 and 147 over all 44 sources at 750k. Canonical V2 remains unauthorized until that catalog screen preserves validity, has positive total completed-track movement, and improvement is non-isolated.
predeclared_screen.non_claim: This focused arm tests one bounded route-depth extension at 750k. It cannot estimate a headline, authorize promotion, or establish multi-budget behavior.
